usage: Usually refers to the music genre, and it can also describe something with a soulful, sad, or mellow feel.
Common with music words like 樂隊, 歌手, and 風格. It sounds natural in everyday Cantonese when talking about genres.
As a noun, it can stand alone or appear after words like 唱, 聽, or 彈 to describe what kind of music someone plays or listens to.
Pretty neutral and widely understood. For more casual speech, people may also just say 音樂類型 or directly name an artist or song style.
